sources.title: TikTok - Make Your Day
sources.snippet: On a device or on the web, viewers can watch and discover millions of personalized short videos. Download the app to get started.

sources.title: Log in | TikTok
sources.snippet: Log in or sign up for an account on TikTok. Start watching to discover real people and real videos that will make your day.
